name: Ula
aliases: Ula, the sea god of Zendikar's merfolk
description: A god of Zendikar whose bident Kiora holds and calls on.

timeline.summary: Flashback: As children, Kiora and Turi listen to Elder Misha's Cosi story about Cosi swapping Ula's spear for a feather.
timeline.quote: Cosi snuck to Ula's bedside at the bottom of the sea and swapped his great spear for a gull's feather

timeline.summary: Kiora finds an altar to the Three in a cave and spits in Ula's face before sleeping beneath Cosi's statue.
timeline.quote: And she spit in Ula's blank, stupid face.

timeline.summary: Kiora tells a Cosi story about a mortal who steals Ula's spear, calling a wave that parts around the merfolk.
timeline.quote: A great wave broke over and around her

timeline.summary: Noyan explains through the story of Ula and the sneeze that the Roil is the world's natural defense against the Eldrazi.
timeline.quote: The Roil built up over time as a natural defense against the presence of the Eldrazi.

relations.note: Zendikar's merfolk gods were unmasked as the titans.
relations.quote: since unmasked as the Eldrazi titans Ulamog, Kozilek, and Emrakul.

relations.note: In the story, Cosi tricks Ula into pursuing a pearl and frees him from the sneeze.
relations.quote: Cosi convinces Ula that there is a powerful magical pearl, hidden deep in the heart of the ocean.

pages_say.description: A false god of Zendikar, proved monstrous and deceitful.
The highest god of Zendikar's merfolk, since unmasked as the Eldrazi titan Ulamog.
One of the three gods of Noyan's people, the figure in a children's story about the ocean's sneeze.
A god of Zendikar whose bident Kiora holds and calls on.
